proposals.old_text: Classify the input into exactly one of: urgent, billing, technical, feature, security, other.
proposals.new_text: Classify the input into one or more of: urgent, billing, technical, feature, security, other.
proposals.hypothesis: Allowing for multiple classifications will help the model capture cases where inputs can belong to more than one category, as seen in several traces.
proposals.expected_improvement: The model will be able to classify inputs that require multiple categories, reducing misclassifications.

proposals.expected_improvement: The model will provide the expected multiple classifications instead of a single category.
